newsitem.title: USA: Dow index racks up second biggest daily gain ever.
newsitem.headline: Dow index racks up second biggest daily gain ever.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average jumped 179 points Tuesday -- just shy of setting a record one-day gain -- as new data calmed Wall Street's fears that the economy was growing at an inflationary pace.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow was up 179.41 points to close at 6,962.43, its second largest gain after the 187-point rise that took placed two days after the "Black Monday" stock crash of Oct. 19, 1987.
In the broader market, advancing issues swamped declines by a huge 4-to-1 margin on heavy volume of 551 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
